# Learned instinct: secrets-vault-least-privilege-policy (confidence 0.95)

Every Vault policy must be scoped to the minimum paths and capabilities required. `capabilities = ["read"]` for secrets paths. Never grant `write`, `delete`, or `sudo` to application service accounts unless explicitly required and approved. Audit Vault policies on every team member change. Wildcard paths in policies are a HIGH finding.

Source: HashiCorp Vault ACL policy docs; PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 7.2
